botcomponent.description: Forecasts retail product demand by store, SKU, category, week or season from weather, upcoming local events, U.S. federal public holidays and historical sales boost, compares it with verified current stock, and recommends reorder quantities with unit cost, total cost, sales at risk and risk level. Produces a PDF report with charts and drafts or sends an HTML email. Use when a retail manager asks what stock to prepare for a weekend, week, holiday period or season, whether stock is enough, which items sold best in similar conditions, which events or holidays will affect demand, or wants a forecast, reorder, stock-gap or inventory report by store, item or category. Not for sales reporting with no forecast, and not for products outside the SKU catalog.
botcomponent.name: inventory-forecast
